request: Analyze GSE217155 for the paper (Role of aerobic exercise in ameliorating NASH: Insights into the hepatic thyroid hormone signaling and circulating thyroid hormones): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of mouse liver (BGISEQ-500; HISAT/Bowtie2/RSEM)

group: Ath diet + 8 wk treadmill aerobic exercise (EXE)

final.sample_inclusion: paper: n=8/group randomized (S2.1.p1); RNA-seq on liver tissues of each group (S3.2.p1); GEO deposits 3/group
final.primary_estimand: effect of 8 weeks aerobic treadmill exercise on the liver transcriptome of Ath-diet NASH mice: NASH+Exercise vs NASH sedentary (S3.2.p1, FIG3B)
planned_contrasts: EXE+Ath vs Ath sedentary (S3.2.p1; paper: 204 DEGs, 79 up / 125 down; Dio1 up)
Ath (NASH) vs NCD control (S3.2.p2, FIG3D/E; GO and GSEA only, no DEG count given)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 (R); GO via DAVID on up/down DEGs; GSEA Hallmark/GO (S2.6.p1)
final.paper_results: 204 DEGs EXE vs NASH (79 up, 125 down); Dio1 up; GSEA in EXE vs NASH: inflammatory/IFN/TNFa/IL6 negative, OXPHOS positive, TGF-beta negative

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S2.1.p1 define three groups (NCD, Ath sedentary, Ath+exercise); S2.6.p1 states DESeq2 with padj<0.05 and |log2FC|>1. Results S3.2.p1 report 204 DEGs (79 up / 125 down) in aerobic-exercised NASH mice vs NASH mice. The NASH vs control comparison is reported only through GO/GSEA (S3.2.p2, S3.2.p3). S2.7 (T3 RRA meta-analysis) uses other GEO series and is out of scope here.

checks: GEO: mouse liver, male C57BL/6, groups Con / Ath diet / EXE+Ath diet match S2.1.p1
contact First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University matches ethics S6.p1

ownership.reasoning: The data availability statement S5.p1 names GSE217155; GEO samples are liver from male mice in the paper's three groups.

alignment.reasoning: Prep script renames matrix columns to GSM ids via metadata title (musCTR3 -> GSM6705771 etc.), so the matrix aligns exactly to the metadata index. grp recodes characteristics_ch1.4.treatment: Con -> CON, Ath diet -> NASH, EXE+Ath diet -> EXE; titles (musCTR/musNASH/musEXE) agree.

matrix.reasoning: Per-sample files carry fpkm_, tpm_ and read_count_ columns (GEO data_processing: RSEM v1.2.8; FPKM, TPM and read count). The read_count columns are RSEM expected counts (mostly integer, some fractional such as 6.99), so they are estimated counts, rounded for DESeq2, which is the paper's stated route (S2.6.p1). The runner's tar merge used the rightmost column per file and dropped GSM6705777 (its file holds all nine samples); the prep script rebuilds the 9-sample read_count matrix and checks the eight single-sample files match it exactly.

candidates.reason_rejected: read counts are deposited and the paper used DESeq2

final.analysis_type: multi-group, one model with planned pairwise contrasts

design.reasoning: The exercise estimand is EXE vs NASH (both Ath diet, differ only in exercise; S2.1.p1, S3.2.p1). NASH vs CON is the diet model check reported in S3.2.p2. EXE vs CON confounds exercise with diet and is not run. One DESeq2 model on all nine samples with planned contrasts, no pooling of levels.

candidates.value: EXE vs CON as the exercise effect
candidates.reason_rejected: differs in both diet and exercise
pools different diets; not the paper's contrast

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one liver sample each; all male, same strain/genotype; no batch, lane or date column in GEO. No repeated measures.

deviations: RSEM expected counts rounded to integers before DESeq2
GEO holds 3 of the paper's 8 mice per group; the paper does not say how many were sequenced

method.reasoning: Paper used DESeq2 (S2.6.p1) on RSEM read counts; pydeseq2 Wald test per contrast from a single ~grp model.

threshold.reasoning: S2.6.p1: adjusted P < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1. Audit: padj < 0.05 without fold-change rule.

caveats: GEO deposits 3 mice/group vs 8 randomized per group in the paper; sequenced n not stated

study.reasoning: Paper reports 204 DEGs (79 up/125 down) and Dio1 up for EXE vs NASH (S3.2.p1); Il1b, Tnf, F4/80 (Adgre1) lower after exercise by qPCR (S3.1.p3).

discrepancies.data: GSM6705777 file holds all nine samples; runner merge dropped it; rebuilt by prep script

executions.name: deseq2_joint
executions.reasoning: One DESeq2 ~grp model on all 9 samples; EXE vs NASH primary, NASH vs CON secondary (diet check).

enrichment.reasoning: paper S3.2.p1 GO on 79 up DEGs
paper S3.2.p1 GO on 125 down DEGs
paper S3.2.p3 GSEA Hallmark (inflammatory, IFN, TNFa, IL6, OXPHOS, TGF-beta)
paper S3.2.p3 GSEA NASH vs control
